stage: JFAMP protocol Section 5: fault metrics, protection and data collection

codeword.unit: one 32-bit logical word of the little-endian serialized encoded payload of one layer
codeword.partial_word_handling: last word zero-padded; padding bits are never fault targets; alignment padding is counted in the byte overhead
codeword.scales_and_metadata: the float32 INT scale of a layer (4 bytes) is stored as one more 32-bit word, protected like the payload, always tested (region 'scale'); no other metadata exists (codec_metadata_bytes = 0)

parity.placement: even parity of the 32 data bits at bit 32

secded.placement: check bits at Hamming positions 1,2,4,8,16,32 (stored bits 0,1,3,7,15,31), overall parity at stored bit 38

dmr.note: extension beyond the protocol table; faults hit copy A only; detect-only

codeword.redundancy_byte_accounting: bits packed densely per layer and rounded up to whole bytes; actual vs nominal overhead both reported

primary.single_data: 1 distinct DATA bit(s) of a codeword flipped
primary.double_data: 2 distinct DATA bit(s) of a codeword flipped

supplementary.single_codeword: 1 distinct bit(s) anywhere in the stored word (parity and SECDED only: includes the redundancy bits)
supplementary.double_codeword: 2 distinct bit(s) anywhere in the stored word (parity and SECDED only: includes the redundancy bits)

sampling.policy: without replacement from the layer's codewords (all if fewer); the same words for every scenario and strategy; same data-bit positions for every strategy in the primary scenarios; per-word seeds derived from sha256(seed|format|layer|region|word|scenario)

reaction_policy: detected-but-not-corrected words are consumed as read; the error stays residual

metrics.correction_rate: data repaired by the code / codewords
metrics.miscorrection_rate: decoder changed a bit and the data is still wrong
metrics.residual_word_error_rate: data read back differs from the original

limits: sampled software tests on stored words, not an exhaustive hardware reliability measurement
model accuracy under faults is NOT re-evaluated here (Stage 4 measured it for the unprotected store)
the SECDED / parity decoder is not part of an inference kernel; only storage and codeword behaviour are characterized
